                    common_stack_len += 1
                else:
                    break

            while len(self.board.move_stack) > common_stack_len + 1:
                self.send_line("remove")
                self.board.pop()
                self.board.pop()

            while len(self.board.move_stack) > common_stack_len:
                self.send_line("undo")
                self.board.pop()

        # Play moves from board stack.
        for move in board.move_stack[common_stack_len:]:
            if not move:
                LOGGER.warning("Null move (in %s) may not be supported by all XBoard engines", self.board.fen())
            self.send_line(self.board.xboard(move))
            self.board.push(move)

    async def ping(self) -> None:
        class XBoardPingCommand(BaseCommand[XBoardProtocol, None]):
            def start(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                n = id(self) & 0xffff
                self.pong = f"pong {n}"
                engine._ping(n)

            def line_received(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, line: str) -> None:
                if line == self.pong:
                    self.result.set_result(None)
                    self.set_finished()
                elif not line.startswith("#"):
                    LOGGER.warning("%s: Unexpected engine output: %r", engine, line)
                elif XBOARD_ERROR_REGEX.match(line):
                    raise EngineError(line)

        return await self.communicate(XBoardPingCommand)

    async def play(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_NONE, ponder: bool = False, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> PlayResult:
        if root_moves is not None:
            raise EngineError("play with root_moves, but xboard supports 'include' only in analysis mode")

        class XBoardPlayCommand(BaseCommand[XBoardProtocol, PlayResult]):
            def start(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                self.play_result = PlayResult(None, None)
                self.stopped = False
                self.pong_after_move: Optional[str] = None
                self.pong_after_ponder: Optional[str] = None

                # Set game, position and configure.
                engine._new(board, game, options)

                # Limit or time control.
                increment = limit.white_inc if board.turn else limit.black_inc
                if limit.remaining_moves or increment:
                    base_mins, base_secs = divmod(int((limit.white_clock if board.turn else limit.black_clock) or 0), 60)
                    engine.send_line(f"level {limit.remaining_moves or 0} {base_mins}:{base_secs:02d} {increment}")

                if limit.nodes is not None:
                    if limit.time is not None or limit.white_clock is not None or limit.black_clock is not None or increment is not None:
                        raise EngineError("xboard does not support mixing node limits with time limits")

                    if "nps" not in engine.features:
                        LOGGER.warning("%s: Engine did not declare explicit support for node limits (feature nps=?)")
                    elif not engine.features["nps"]:
                        raise EngineError("xboard engine does not support node limits (feature nps=0)")

                    engine.send_line("nps 1")
                    engine.send_line(f"st {max(1, int(limit.nodes))}")
                if limit.depth is not None:
                    engine.send_line(f"sd {max(1, int(limit.depth))}")
                if limit.time is not None:
                    engine.send_line(f"st {max(0.01, limit.time)}")
                if limit.white_clock is not None:
                    engine.send_line("{} {}".format("time" if board.turn else "otim", max(1, int(limit.white_clock * 100))))
                if limit.black_clock is not None:
                    engine.send_line("{} {}".format("otim" if board.turn else "time", max(1, int(limit.black_clock * 100))))

                # Start thinking.
                engine.send_line("post" if info else "nopost")
                engine.send_line("hard" if ponder else "easy")
                engine.send_line("go")

            def line_received(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, line: str) -> None:
                if line.startswith("move "):
                    self._move(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
                elif line.startswith("Hint: "):
                    self._hint(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
                elif line == self.pong_after_move:
                    if not self.result.done():
                        self.result.set_result(self.play_result)
                    if not ponder:
                        self.set_finished()
                elif line == self.pong_after_ponder:
                    if not self.result.done():
                        self.result.set_result(self.play_result)
                    self.set_finished()
                elif line == "offer draw":
                    if not self.result.done():
                        self.play_result.draw_offered = True
                    self._ping_after_move(engine)
                elif line == "resign":
                    if not self.result.done():
                        self.play_result.resigned = True
                    self._ping_after_move(engine)
                elif line.startswith("1-0") or line.startswith("0-1") or line.startswith("1/2-1/2"):
                    self._ping_after_move(engine)
                elif line.startswith("#"):
                    pass
                elif XBOARD_ERROR_REGEX.match(line):
                    engine.first_game = True  # Board state might no longer be in sync
                    raise EngineError(line)
                elif len(line.split()) >= 4 and line.lstrip()[0].isdigit():
                    self._post(engine, line)
                else:
                    LOGGER.warning("%s: Unexpected engine output: %r", engine, line)

            def _post(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, line: str) -> None:
                if not self.result.done():
                    self.play_result.info = _parse_xboard_post(line, engine.board, info)

            def _move(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
                if not self.result.done() and self.play_result.move is None:
                    try:
                        self.play_result.move = engine.board.push_xboard(arg)
                    except ValueError as err:
                        self.result.set_exception(EngineError(err))
                    else:
                        self._ping_after_move(engine)
                else:
                    try:
                        engine.board.push_xboard(arg)
                    except ValueError:
                        LOGGER.exception("Exception playing unexpected move")

            def _hint(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
                if not self.result.done() and self.play_result.move is not None and self.play_result.ponder is None:
                    try:
                        self.play_result.ponder = engine.board.parse_xboard(arg)
                    except ValueError:
                        LOGGER.exception("Exception parsing hint")
                else:
                    LOGGER.warning("Unexpected hint: %r", arg)

            def _ping_after_move(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                if self.pong_after_move is None:
                    n = id(self) & 0xffff
                    self.pong_after_move = f"pong {n}"
                    engine._ping(n)

            def cancel(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                if self.stopped:
                    return
                self.stopped = True

                if self.result.cancelled():
                    engine.send_line("?")

                if ponder:
                    engine.send_line("easy")

                    n = (id(self) + 1) & 0xffff
                    self.pong_after_ponder = f"pong {n}"
                    engine._ping(n)

            def engine_terminated(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, exc: Exception) -> None:
                # Allow terminating engine while pondering.
                if not self.result.done():
                    super().engine_terminated(engine, exc)

        return await self.communicate(XBoardPlayCommand)

    async def analysis(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Optional[Limit] = None, *, multipv: Optional[int] = None, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> AnalysisResult:
        if multipv is not None:
            raise EngineError("xboard engine does not support multipv")

        if limit is not None and (limit.white_clock is not None or limit.black_clock is not None):
            raise EngineError("xboard analysis does not support clock limits")

        class XBoardAnalysisCommand(BaseCommand[XBoardProtocol, AnalysisResult]):
            def start(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                self.stopped = False
                self.best_move: Optional[chess.Move] = None
                self.analysis = AnalysisResult(stop=lambda: self.cancel(engine))
                self.final_pong: Optional[str] = None

                engine._new(board, game, options)

                if root_moves is not None:
                    if not engine.features.get("exclude", 0):
                        raise EngineError("xboard engine does not support root_moves (feature exclude=0)")

                    engine.send_line("exclude all")
                    for move in root_moves:
                        engine.send_line(f"include {engine.board.xboard(move)}")

                engine.send_line("post")
                engine.send_line("analyze")

                self.result.set_result(self.analysis)

                if limit is not None and limit.time is not None:
                    self.time_limit_handle: Optional[asyncio.Handle] = engine.loop.call_later(limit.time, lambda: self.cancel(engine))
                else:
                    self.time_limit_handle = None

            def line_received(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, line: str) -> None:
                if line.startswith("#"):
                    pass
                elif len(line.split()) >= 4 and line.lstrip()[0].isdigit():
                    self._post(engine, line)
                elif line == self.final_pong:
                    self.end(engine)
                elif XBOARD_ERROR_REGEX.match(line):
                    engine.first_game = True  # Board state might no longer be in sync
                    raise EngineError(line)
                else:
                    LOGGER.warning("%s: Unexpected engine output: %r", engine, line)

            def _post(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, line: str) -> None:
                post_info = _parse_xboard_post(line, engine.board, info)
                self.analysis.post(post_info)

                pv = post_info.get("pv")
                if pv:
                    self.best_move = pv[0]

                if limit is not None:
                    if limit.time is not None and post_info.get("time", 0) >= limit.time:
                        self.cancel(engine)
                    elif limit.nodes is not None and post_info.get("nodes", 0) >= limit.nodes:
                        self.cancel(engine)
                    elif limit.depth is not None and post_info.get("depth", 0) >= limit.depth:
                        self.cancel(engine)
                    elif limit.mate is not None and "score" in post_info:
                        if post_info["score"].relative >= Mate(limit.mate):
                            self.cancel(engine)

            def end(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                if self.time_limit_handle:
                    self.time_limit_handle.cancel()

                self.set_finished()
                self.analysis.set_finished(BestMove(self.best_move, None))

            def cancel(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                if self.stopped:
                    return
                self.stopped = True

                engine.send_line(".")
                engine.send_line("exit")

                n = id(self) & 0xffff
                self.final_pong = f"pong {n}"
                engine._ping(n)

            def engine_terminated(self, engine: XBoardProtocol, exc: Exception) -> None:
                LOGGER.debug("%s: Closing analysis because engine has been terminated (error: %s)", engine, exc)

                if self.time_limit_handle:
                    self.time_limit_handle.cancel()

                self.analysis.set_exception(exc)

        return await self.communicate(XBoardAnalysisCommand)

    def _setoption(self, name: str, value: ConfigValue) -> None:
        if value is not None and value == self.config.get(name):
            return

        try:
            option = self.options[name]
        except KeyError:
            raise EngineError(f"unsupported xboard option or command: {name}")

        self.config[name] = value = option.parse(value)

        if name in ["random", "computer"]:
            # Applied in _new.
            pass
        elif name in ["memory", "cores"] or name.startswith("egtpath "):
            self.send_line(f"{name} {value}")
        elif value is None:
            self.send_line(f"option {name}")
        elif value is True:
            self.send_line(f"option {name}=1")
        elif value is False:
            self.send_line(f"option {name}=0")
        else:
            self.send_line(f"option {name}={value}")

    def _configure(self, options: ConfigMapping) -> None:
        for name, value in collections.ChainMap(options, self.target_config).items():
            if name.lower() in MANAGED_OPTIONS:
                raise EngineError(f"cannot set {name} which is automatically managed")
            self._setoption(name, value)

    async def configure(self, options: ConfigMapping) -> None:
        class XBoardConfigureCommand(BaseCommand[XBoardProtocol, None]):
            def start(self, engine: XBoardProtocol) -> None:
                engine._configure(options)
                engine.target_config.update({name: value for name, value in options.items() if value is not None})
                self.result.set_result(None)
                self.set_finished()

        return await self.communicate(XBoardConfigureCommand)

    async def quit(self) -> None:
        self.send_line("quit")
        await asyncio.shield(self.returncode)


def _parse_xboard_option(feature: str) -> Option:
    params = feature.split()

    name = params[0]
    type = params[1][1:]
    default: Optional[ConfigValue] = None
    min = None
    max = None
    var = None

    if type == "combo":
        var = []
        choices = params[2:]
        for choice in choices:
            if choice == "///":
                continue
            elif choice[0] == "*":
                default = choice[1:]
                var.append(choice[1:])
            else:
                var.append(choice)
    elif type == "check":
        default = int(params[2])
    elif type in ["string", "file", "path"]:
        if len(params) > 2:
            default = params[2]
        else:
            default = ""
    elif type == "spin":
        default = int(params[2])
        min = int(params[3])
        max = int(params[4])

    return Option(name, type, default, min, max, var)


def _parse_xboard_post(line: str, root_board: chess.Board, selector: Info = INFO_ALL) -> InfoDict:
    # Format: depth score time nodes [seldepth [nps [tbhits]]] pv
    info: InfoDict = {}

    # Split leading integer tokens from pv.
    pv_tokens = line.split()
    integer_tokens = []
    while pv_tokens:
        token = pv_tokens.pop(0)
        try:
            integer_tokens.append(int(token))
        except ValueError:
            pv_tokens.insert(0, token)
            break

    if len(integer_tokens) < 4:
        return info

    # Required integer tokens.
    info["depth"] = integer_tokens.pop(0)
    cp = integer_tokens.pop(0)
    info["time"] = int(integer_tokens.pop(0)) / 100
    info["nodes"] = int(integer_tokens.pop(0))

    # Score.
    if cp <= -100000:
        score: Score = Mate(cp + 100000)
    elif cp == 100000:
        score = MateGiven
    elif cp >= 100000:
        score = Mate(cp - 100000)
    else:
        score = Cp(cp)
    info["score"] = PovScore(score, root_board.turn)

    # Optional integer tokens.
    if integer_tokens:
        info["seldepth"] = integer_tokens.pop(0)
    if integer_tokens:
        info["nps"] = integer_tokens.pop(0)

    while len(integer_tokens) > 1:
        # Reserved for future extensions.
        integer_tokens.pop(0)

    if integer_tokens:
        info["tbhits"] = integer_tokens.pop(0)

    # Principal variation.
    pv = []
    board = root_board.copy(stack=False)
    for token in pv_tokens:
        if token.rstrip(".").isdigit():
            continue

        try:
            pv.append(board.push_xboard(token))
        except ValueError:
            break

        if not (selector & INFO_PV):
            break
    info["pv"] = pv

    return info


class BestMove:
    """Returned by :func:`chess.engine.AnalysisResult.wait()`."""

    move: Optional[chess.Move]
    """The best move according to the engine, or ``None``."""

    ponder: Optional[chess.Move]
    """The response that the engine expects after *move*, or ``None``."""

    def __init__(self, move: Optional[chess.Move], ponder: Optional[chess.Move]):
        self.move = move
        self.ponder = ponder

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return "<{} at {:#x} (move={}, ponder={}>".format(
            type(self).__name__, id(self), self.move, self.ponder)


class AnalysisResult:
    """
    Handle to ongoing engine analysis.
    Returned by :func:`chess.engine.Protocol.analysis()`.

    Can be used to asynchronously iterate over information sent by the engine.

    Automatically stops the analysis when used as a context manager.
    """

    multipv: List[chess.engine.InfoDict]
    """
    A list of dictionaries with aggregated information sent by the engine.
    One item for each root move.
    """

    def __init__(self, stop: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None):
        self._stop = stop
        self._queue: asyncio.Queue[InfoDict] = asyncio.Queue()
        self._posted_kork = False
        self._seen_kork = False
        self._finished: asyncio.Future[BestMove] = asyncio.Future()
        self.multipv = [{}]

    def post(self, info: InfoDict) -> None:
        # Empty dictionary reserved for kork.
        if not info:
            return

        multipv = info.get("multipv", 1)
        while len(self.multipv) < multipv:
            self.multipv.append({})
        self.multipv[multipv - 1].update(info)

        self._queue.put_nowait(info)

    def _kork(self) -> None:
        if not self._posted_kork:
            self._posted_kork = True
            self._queue.put_nowait({})

    def set_finished(self, best: BestMove) -> None:
        if not self._finished.done():
            self._finished.set_result(best)
        self._kork()

    def set_exception(self, exc: Exception) -> None:
        self._finished.set_exception(exc)
        self._kork()

    @property
    def info(self) -> InfoDict:
        """
        A dictionary of aggregated information sent by the engine. This is
        actually an alias for ``multipv[0]``.
        """
        return self.multipv[0]

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Stops the analysis as soon as possible."""
        if self._stop and not self._posted_kork:
            self._stop()
            self._stop = None

    async def wait(self) -> BestMove:
        """Waits until the analysis is complete (or stopped)."""
        return await self._finished

    async def get(self) -> InfoDict:
        """
        Waits for the next dictionary of information from the engine and
        returns it.

        It might be more convenient to use ``async for info in analysis: ...``.

        :raises: :exc:`chess.engine.AnalysisComplete` if the analysis is
            complete (or has been stopped) and all information has been
            consumed. Use :func:`~chess.engine.AnalysisResult.next()` if you
            prefer to get ``None`` instead of an exception.
        """
        if self._seen_kork:
            raise AnalysisComplete()

        info = await self._queue.get()
        if not info:
            # Empty dictionary marks end.
            self._seen_kork = True
            await self._finished
            raise AnalysisComplete()

        return info

    def empty(self) -> bool:
        """
        Checks if all information has been consumed.

        If the queue is empty, but the analysis is still ongoing, then further
        information can become available in the future.

        If the queue is not empty, then the next call to
        :func:`~chess.engine.AnalysisResult.get()` will return instantly.
        """
        return self._seen_kork or self._queue.qsize() <= self._posted_kork

    async def next(self) -> Optional[InfoDict]:
        try:
            return await self.get()
        except AnalysisComplete:
            return None

    def __aiter__(self) -> AnalysisResult:
        return self

    async def __anext__(self) -> InfoDict:
        try:
            return await self.get()
        except AnalysisComplete:
            raise StopAsyncIteration

    def __enter__(self) -> AnalysisResult:
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type: Optional[Type[BaseException]], exc_value: Optional[BaseException], traceback: Optional[TracebackType]) -> None:
        self.stop()


async def popen_uci(command: Union[str, List[str]], *, setpgrp: bool = False, **popen_args: Any) -> Tuple[asyncio.SubprocessTransport, UciProtocol]:
    """
    Spawns and initializes a UCI engine.

    :param command: Path of the engine executable, or a list including the
        path and arguments.
    :param setpgrp: Open the engine process in a new process group. This will
        stop signals (such as keyboard interrupts) from propagating from the
        parent process. Defaults to ``False``.
    :param popen_args: Additional arguments for
        `popen <https://docs.python.org/3/library/subprocess.html#popen-constructor>`_.
        Do not set ``stdin``, ``stdout``, ``bufsize`` or
        ``universal_newlines``.

    Returns a subprocess transport and engine protocol pair.
    """
    transport, protocol = await UciProtocol.popen(command, setpgrp=setpgrp, **popen_args)
    try:
        await protocol.initialize()
    except:
        transport.close()
        raise
    return transport, protocol

class SimpleEngine:
    """
    Synchronous wrapper around a transport and engine protocol pair. Provides
    the same methods and attributes as :class:`chess.engine.Protocol`
    with blocking functions instead of coroutines.

    You may not concurrently modify objects passed to any of the methods. Other
    than that, :class:`~chess.engine.SimpleEngine` is thread-safe. When sending
    a new command to the engine, any previous running command will be cancelled
    as soon as possible.

    Methods will raise :class:`asyncio.TimeoutError` if an operation takes
    *timeout* seconds longer than expected (unless *timeout* is ``None``).

    Automatically closes the transport when used as a context manager.
    """

    def __init__(self, transport: asyncio.SubprocessTransport, protocol: Protocol, *, timeout: Optional[float] = 10.0) -> None:
        self.transport = transport
        self.protocol = protocol
        self.timeout = timeout

        self._shutdown_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._shutdown = False
        self.shutdown_event = asyncio.Event()

        self.returncode: concurrent.futures.Future[int] = concurrent.futures.Future()

    def _timeout_for(self, limit: Optional[Limit]) -> Optional[float]:
        if self.timeout is None or limit is None or limit.time is None:
            return None
        return self.timeout + limit.time

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _not_shut_down(self) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
        with self._shutdown_lock:
            if self._shutdown:
                raise EngineTerminatedError("engine event loop dead")
            yield

    @property
    def options(self) -> MutableMapping[str, Option]:
        async def _get() -> MutableMapping[str, Option]:
            return copy.copy(self.protocol.options)

        with self._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(_get(), self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    @property
    def id(self) -> Mapping[str, str]:
        async def _get() -> Mapping[str, str]:
            return self.protocol.id.copy()

        with self._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(_get(), self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def communicate(self, command_factory: Callable[[], BaseCommand[Protocol, T]]) -> T:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = self.protocol.communicate(command_factory)
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def configure(self, options: ConfigMapping) -> None:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = asyncio.wait_for(self.protocol.configure(options), self.timeout)
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def ping(self) -> None:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = asyncio.wait_for(self.protocol.ping(), self.timeout)
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def play(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_NONE, ponder: bool = False, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> PlayResult:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = asyncio.wait_for(
                self.protocol.play(board, limit, game=game, info=info, ponder=ponder, root_moves=root_moves, options=options),
                self._timeout_for(limit))
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    @typing.overload
    def analyse(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> InfoDict: ...
    @typing.overload
    def analyse(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, multipv: int, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> List[InfoDict]: ...
    @typing.overload
    def analyse(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, multipv: Optional[int] = None, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> Union[InfoDict, List[InfoDict]]: ...
    def analyse(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, multipv: Optional[int] = None, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> Union[InfoDict, List[InfoDict]]:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = asyncio.wait_for(
                self.protocol.analyse(board, limit, multipv=multipv, game=game, info=info, root_moves=root_moves, options=options),
                self._timeout_for(limit))
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def analysis(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Optional[Limit] = None, *, multipv: Optional[int] = None, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> SimpleAnalysisResult:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = asyncio.wait_for(
                self.protocol.analysis(board, limit, multipv=multipv, game=game, info=info, root_moves=root_moves, options=options),
                self.timeout)  # Timeout until analysis is *started*
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return SimpleAnalysisResult(self, future.result())

    def quit(self) -> None:
        with self._not_shut_down():
            coro = asyncio.wait_for(self.protocol.quit(), self.timeout)
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(coro, self.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def close(self) -> None:
        """
        Closes the transport and the background event loop as soon as possible.
        """
        def _shutdown() -> None:
            self.transport.close()
            self.shutdown_event.set()

        with self._shutdown_lock:
            if not self._shutdown:
                self._shutdown = True
                self.protocol.loop.call_soon_threadsafe(_shutdown)

    @classmethod
    def popen(cls, Protocol: Type[Protocol], command: Union[str, List[str]], *, timeout: Optional[float] = 10.0, debug: bool = False, setpgrp: bool = False, **popen_args: Any) -> SimpleEngine:
        async def background(future: concurrent.futures.Future[SimpleEngine]) -> None:
            transport, protocol = await Protocol.popen(command, setpgrp=setpgrp, **popen_args)
            threading.current_thread().name = f"{cls.__name__} (pid={transport.get_pid()})"
            simple_engine = cls(transport, protocol, timeout=timeout)
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(protocol.initialize(), timeout)
                future.set_result(simple_engine)
                returncode = await protocol.returncode
                simple_engine.returncode.set_result(returncode)
            finally:
                simple_engine.close()
            await simple_engine.shutdown_event.wait()

        return run_in_background(background, name=f"{cls.__name__} (command={command!r})", debug=debug)

    @classmethod
    def popen_uci(cls, command: Union[str, List[str]], *, timeout: Optional[float] = 10.0, debug: bool = False, setpgrp: bool = False, **popen_args: Any) -> SimpleEngine:
        """
        Spawns and initializes a UCI engine.
        Returns a :class:`~chess.engine.SimpleEngine` instance.
        """
        return cls.popen(UciProtocol, command, timeout=timeout, debug=debug, setpgrp=setpgrp, **popen_args)

    @classmethod
    def popen_xboard(cls, command: Union[str, List[str]], *, timeout: Optional[float] = 10.0, debug: bool = False, setpgrp: bool = False, **popen_args: Any) -> SimpleEngine:
        """
        Spawns and initializes an XBoard engine.
        Returns a :class:`~chess.engine.SimpleEngine` instance.
        """
        return cls.popen(XBoardProtocol, command, timeout=timeout, debug=debug, setpgrp=setpgrp, **popen_args)

    def __enter__(self) -> SimpleEngine:
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type: Optional[Type[BaseException]], exc_value: Optional[BaseException], traceback: Optional[TracebackType]) -> None:
        self.close()

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        pid = self.transport.get_pid()  # This happens to be thread-safe
        return f"<{type(self).__name__} (pid={pid})>"

    """

        return future.result()

    @property
    def multipv(self) -> List[InfoDict]:

        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(_get(), self.simple_engine.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            self.simple_engine.protocol.loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self.inner.stop)

    def wait(self) -> BestMove:
        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self.inner.wait(), self.simple_engine.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def empty(self) -> bool:
        async def _empty() -> bool:
            return self.inner.empty()

        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(_empty(), self.simple_engine.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def get(self) -> InfoDict:
        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self.inner.get(), self.simple_engine.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def next(self) -> Optional[InfoDict]:
        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self.inner.next(), self.simple_engine.protocol.loop)
        return future.result()

    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[InfoDict]:
        with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
            self.simple_engine.protocol.loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self.inner.__aiter__)
        return self

    def __next__(self) -> InfoDict:
        try:
            with self.simple_engine._not_shut_down():
                future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self.inner.__anext__(), self.simple_engine.protocol.loop)
            return future.result()
        except StopAsyncIteration:
            raise StopIteration

    def __enter__(self) -> SimpleAnalysisResult:
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type: Optional[Type[BaseException]], exc_value: Optional[BaseException], traceback: Optional[TracebackType]) -> None:
        self.stop()

Look at the following list of code idiom specifications with definitions and examples:
# Idiom 525 (Async Generator Opportunity)

Definition: Introduces asynchronous generator functions so that asynchronous iteration can be written using "async for" syntax.

Rationale: asynchronous iteration was forced to use synchronous generators or manual event loop management. This led to verbose, error-prone code that was hard to read and maintain. Developers had to implement complex workarounds, which not only cluttered the codebase but also introduced subtle bugs and inefficiencies.

Example:
class Ticker:
    """Yield numbers from 0 to `to` every `delay` seconds."""

    def __init__(self, delay, to):
        self.delay = delay
        self.i = 0
        self.to = to

    def __aiter__(self):
        return self

    async def __anext__(self):
        i = self.i
        if i >= self.to:
            raise StopAsyncIteration
        self.i += 1
        if i:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
        return i

Use instead:

async def ticker(delay, to):
    """Yield numbers from 0 to `to` every `delay` seconds."""
    for i in range(to):
        yield i
        await asyncio.sleep(delay)

 65 class EventLoopPolicy(asyncio.AbstractEventLoopPolicy):
 66     """
 67     An event loop policy for thread-local event loops and child watchers.
 68     Ensures each event loop is capable of spawning and watching subprocesses,
 69     even when not running on the main thread.
 70 
 71     Windows: Uses :class:`~asyncio.ProactorEventLoop`.
 72 
 73     Unix: Uses :class:`~asyncio.SelectorEventLoop`. If available,
 74     :class:`~asyncio.PidfdChildWatcher` is used to detect subprocess
 75     termination (Python 3.9+ on Linux 5.3+). Otherwise, the default child
 76     watcher is used on the main thread and relatively slow eager polling
 77     is used on all other threads.
 78     """
 79     class _Local(threading.local):
 80         loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None
 81         set_called = False
 82         watcher: Optional[asyncio.AbstractChildWatcher] = None
 83 
 84     def __init__(self) -> None:
 85         self._local = self._Local()
 86 
 87     def get_event_loop(self) -> asyncio.AbstractEventLoop:
 88         if self._local.loop is None and not self._local.set_called and threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread():
 89             self.set_event_loop(self.new_event_loop())
 90         if self._local.loop is None:
 91             raise RuntimeError(f"no current event loop in thread {threading.current_thread().name!r}")
 92         return self._local.loop
 93 
 94     def set_event_loop(self, loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop]) -> None:
 95         assert loop is None or isinstance(loop, asyncio.AbstractEventLoop)
 96         self._local.set_called = True
 97         self._local.loop = loop
 98         if self._local.watcher is not None:
 99             self._local.watcher.attach_loop(loop)
100 
101     def new_event_loop(self) -> asyncio.AbstractEventLoop:
102         return asyncio.ProactorEventLoop() if sys.platform == "win32" else asyncio.SelectorEventLoop()  # type: ignore
103 
104     def get_child_watcher(self) -> asyncio.AbstractChildWatcher:
105         if self._local.watcher is None:
106             self._local.watcher = self._init_watcher()
107             self._local.watcher.attach_loop(self._local.loop)
108         return self._local.watcher
109 
110     def set_child_watcher(self, watcher: Optional[asyncio.AbstractChildWatcher]) -> None:
111         assert watcher is None or isinstance(watcher, asyncio.AbstractChildWatcher)
112         if self._local.watcher is not None:
113             self._local.watcher.close()
114         self._local.watcher = watcher
115 
116     def _init_watcher(self) -> asyncio.AbstractChildWatcher:
117         if sys.platform == "win32":
118             raise NotImplementedError
119 
120         try:
121             os.close(os.pidfd_open(os.getpid()))  # type: ignore
122             watcher: asyncio.AbstractChildWatcher = asyncio.PidfdChildWatcher()  # type: ignore
123             LOGGER.debug("Using PidfdChildWatcher")
124             return watcher
125         except (AttributeError, OSError):
126             # Before Python 3.9 or before Linux 5.3 or the syscall is not
127             # permitted.
128             pass
129 
130         if threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread():
131             try:
132                 watcher = asyncio.ThreadedChildWatcher()
133                 LOGGER.debug("Using ThreadedChildWatcher")
134                 return watcher
135             except AttributeError:
136                 # Before Python 3.8.
137                 LOGGER.debug("Using SafeChildWatcher")
138                 return asyncio.SafeChildWatcher()
139 
140         class PollingChildWatcher(asyncio.SafeChildWatcher):
141             _loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop]
142             _callbacks: Dict[int, Any]
143 
144             def __init__(self) -> None:
145                 super().__init__()
146                 self._poll_handle: Optional[asyncio.Handle] = None
147                 self._poll_delay = 0.001
148 
149             def attach_loop(self, loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop]) -> None:
150                 assert loop is None or isinstance(loop, asyncio.AbstractEventLoop)
151 
152                 if self._loop is not None and loop is None and self._callbacks:
153                     warnings.warn("A loop is being detached from a child watcher with pending handlers", RuntimeWarning)
154 
155                 if self._poll_handle is not None:
156                     self._poll_handle.cancel()
157 
158                 self._loop = loop
159                 if self._loop is not None:
160                     self._poll_handle = self._loop.call_soon(self._poll)
161                     self._do_waitpid_all()  # type: ignore
162 
163             def _poll(self) -> None:
164                 if self._loop:
165                     self._do_waitpid_all()  # type: ignore
166                     self._poll_delay = min(self._poll_delay * 2, 1.0)
167                     self._poll_handle = self._loop.call_later(self._poll_delay, self._poll)
168 
169         LOGGER.debug("Using PollingChildWatcher")
170         return PollingChildWatcher()

173 def run_in_background(coroutine: Callable[[concurrent.futures.Future[T]], Coroutine[Any, Any, None]], *, name: Optional[str] = None, debug: bool = False, _policy_lock: threading.Lock = threading.Lock()) -> T:
174     """
175     Runs ``coroutine(future)`` in a new event loop on a background thread.
176 
177     Blocks on *future* and returns the result as soon as it is resolved.
178     The coroutine and all remaining tasks continue running in the background
179     until complete.
180 
181     Note: This installs a :class:`chess.engine.EventLoopPolicy` for the entire
182     process.
183     """
184     assert asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(coroutine)
185 
186     with _policy_lock:
187         if not isinstance(asyncio.get_event_loop_policy(), EventLoopPolicy):
188             asyncio.set_event_loop_policy(EventLoopPolicy())
189 
190     future: concurrent.futures.Future[T] = concurrent.futures.Future()
191 
192     def background() -> None:
193         try:
194             asyncio.run(coroutine(future))
195             future.cancel()
196         except Exception as exc:
197             future.set_exception(exc)
198 
199     threading.Thread(target=background, name=name).start()
200     return future.result()

541     @abc.abstractmethod
542     def wdl(self, *, model: _WdlModel = "sf12", ply: int = 30) -> Wdl:
543         """
544         Returns statistics for the expected outcome of this game, based on
545         a *model*, given that this score is reached at *ply*.
546 
547         Scores have a total order, but it makes little sense to compute
548         the difference between two scores. For example, going from
549         ``Cp(-100)`` to ``Cp(+100)`` is much more significant than going
550         from ``Cp(+300)`` to ``Cp(+500)``. It is better to compute differences
551         of the expectation values for the outcome of the game (based on winning
552         chances and drawing chances).
553 
554         >>> Cp(100).wdl().expectation() - Cp(-100).wdl().expectation()  # doctest: +ELLIPSIS
555         0.379...
556 
557         >>> Cp(500).wdl().expectation() - Cp(300).wdl().expectation()  # doctest: +ELLIPSIS
558         0.015...
559 
560         :param model:
561             * ``sf12``, the WDL model used by Stockfish 12.
562             * ``lichess``, the win rate model used by Lichess.
563               Does not use *ply*, and does not consider drawing chances.
564         :param ply: The number of half-moves played since the starting
565             position. Models may scale scores slightly differently based on
566             this. Defaults to middle game.
567         """

622 def _sf12_wins(cp: int, *, ply: int) -> int:
623     # https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/blob/sf_12/src/uci.cpp#L198-L218
624     m = min(240, max(ply, 0)) / 64
625     a = (((-8.24404295 * m + 64.23892342) * m + -95.73056462) * m) + 153.86478679
626     b = (((-3.37154371 * m + 28.44489198) * m + -56.67657741) * m) + 72.05858751
627     x = min(1000, max(cp, -1000))
628     return int(0.5 + 1000 / (1 + math.exp((a - x) / b)))
629 
630 def _lichess_raw_wins(cp: int) -> int:
631     return round(1000 / (1 + math.exp(-0.004 * cp)))
632

819 @dataclasses.dataclass
820 class Wdl:
821     """Win/draw/loss statistics."""
822 
823     wins: int
824     """The number of wins."""
825 
826     draws: int
827     """The number of draws."""
828 
829     losses: int
830     """The number of losses."""
831 
832     def total(self) -> int:
833         """
834         Returns the total number of games. Usually, ``wdl`` reported by engines
835         is scaled to 1000 games.
836         """
837         return self.wins + self.draws + self.losses
838 
839     def winning_chance(self) -> float:
840         """Returns the relative frequency of wins."""
841         return self.wins / self.total()
842 
843     def drawing_chance(self) -> float:
844         """Returns the relative frequency of draws."""
845         return self.draws / self.total()
846 
847     def losing_chance(self) -> float:
848         """Returns the relative frequency of losses."""
849         return self.losses / self.total()
850 
851     def expectation(self) -> float:
852         """
853         Returns the expectation value, where a win is valued 1, a draw is
854         valued 0.5, and a loss is valued 0.
855         """
856         return (self.wins + 0.5 * self.draws) / self.total()
857 
858     def __bool__(self) -> bool:
859         return bool(self.total())
860 
861     def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[int]:
862         yield self.wins
863         yield self.draws
864         yield self.losses
865 
866     def __reversed__(self) -> Iterator[int]:
867         yield self.losses
868         yield self.draws
869         yield self.wins
870 
871     def __pos__(self) -> Wdl:
872         return self
873 
874     def __neg__(self) -> Wdl:
875         return Wdl(self.losses, self.draws, self.wins)

880         super().__init__()
881         self.protocol = protocol
882         self.expectations: Deque[Tuple[str, List[str]]] = collections.deque()
883         self.expected_pings = 0
884         self.stdin_buffer = bytearray()
885         self.protocol.connection_made(self)
886 
887     def expect(self, expectation: str, responses: List[str] = []) -> None:
888         self.expectations.append((expectation, responses))
889 
890     def expect_ping(self) -> None:
891         self.expected_pings += 1
892 
893     def assert_done(self) -> None:
894         assert not self.expectations, f"pending expectations: {self.expectations}"
895

897         assert fd == 0, f"expected 0 for stdin, got {fd}"
898         return self

900     def write(self, data: bytes) -> None:
901         self.stdin_buffer.extend(data)
902         while b"\n" in self.stdin_buffer:
903             line_bytes, self.stdin_buffer = self.stdin_buffer.split(b"\n", 1)
904             line = line_bytes.decode("utf-8")
905 
906             if line.startswith("ping ") and self.expected_pings:
907                 self.expected_pings -= 1
908                 self.protocol.pipe_data_received(1, line.replace("ping ", "pong ").encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
909             else:
910                 assert self.expectations, f"unexpected: {line!r}"
911                 expectation, responses = self.expectations.popleft()
912                 assert expectation == line, f"expected {expectation}, got: {line}"
913                 if responses:
914                     self.protocol.pipe_data_received(1, "\n".join(responses).encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
915

917         return id(self)
918

920         return None if self.expectations else 0

923 class Protocol(asyncio.SubprocessProtocol, metaclass=abc.ABCMeta):
924     """Protocol for communicating with a chess engine process."""
925 
926     options: MutableMapping[str, Option]
927     """Dictionary of available options."""
928 
929     id: Dict[str, str]
930     """
931     Dictionary of information about the engine. Common keys are ``name``
932     and ``author``.
933     """
934 
935     returncode: asyncio.Future[int]
936     """Future: Exit code of the process."""
937 
938     def __init__(self: ProtocolT) -> None:
939         self.loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
940         self.transport: Optional[asyncio.SubprocessTransport] = None
941 
942         self.buffer = {
943             1: bytearray(),  # stdout
944             2: bytearray(),  # stderr
945         }
946 
947         self.command: Optional[BaseCommand[ProtocolT, Any]] = None
948         self.next_command: Optional[BaseCommand[ProtocolT, Any]] = None
949 
950         self.initialized = False
951         self.returncode: asyncio.Future[int] = asyncio.Future()
952 
953     def connection_made(self, transport: asyncio.BaseTransport) -> None:
954         # SubprocessTransport expected, but not checked to allow duck typing.
955         self.transport = transport  # type: ignore
956         LOGGER.debug("%s: Connection made", self)
957 
958     def connection_lost(self: ProtocolT, exc: Optional[Exception]) -> None:
959         assert self.transport is not None
960         code = self.transport.get_returncode()
961         assert code is not None, "connect lost, but got no returncode"
962         LOGGER.debug("%s: Connection lost (exit code: %d, error: %s)", self, code, exc)
963 
964         # Terminate commands.
965         if self.command is not None:
966             self.command._engine_terminated(self, code)
967             self.command = None
968         if self.next_command is not None:
969             self.next_command._engine_terminated(self, code)
970             self.next_command = None
971 
972         self.returncode.set_result(code)
973 
974     def process_exited(self) -> None:
975         LOGGER.debug("%s: Process exited", self)
976 
977     def send_line(self, line: str) -> None:
978         LOGGER.debug("%s: << %s", self, line)
979         assert self.transport is not None, "cannot send line before connection is made"
980         stdin = self.transport.get_pipe_transport(0)
981         # WriteTransport expected, but not checked to allow duck typing.
982         stdin.write(line.encode("utf-8"))  # type: ignore
983         stdin.write(b"\n")  # type: ignore
984 
985     def pipe_data_received(self, fd: int, data: Union[bytes, str]) -> None:
986         self.buffer[fd].extend(data)  # type: ignore
987         while b"\n" in self.buffer[fd]:
988             line_bytes, self.buffer[fd] = self.buffer[fd].split(b"\n", 1)
989             if line_bytes.endswith(b"\r"):
990                 line_bytes = line_bytes[:-1]
991             try:
992                 line = line_bytes.decode("utf-8")
993             except UnicodeDecodeError as err:
994                 LOGGER.warning("%s: >> %r (%s)", self, bytes(line_bytes), err)
995             else:
996                 if fd == 1:
997                     self.loop.call_soon(self._line_received, line)
998                 else:
999                     self.loop.call_soon(self.error_line_received, line)
1000 
1001     def error_line_received(self, line: str) -> None:
1002         LOGGER.warning("%s: stderr >> %s", self, line)
1003 
1004     def _line_received(self: ProtocolT, line: str) -> None:
1005         LOGGER.debug("%s: >> %s", self, line)
1006 
1007         self.line_received(line)
1008 
1009         if self.command:
1010             self.command._line_received(self, line)
1011 
1012     def line_received(self, line: str) -> None:
1013         pass
1014 
1015     async def communicate(self: ProtocolT, command_factory: Callable[[], BaseCommand[ProtocolT, T]]) -> T:
1016         command = command_factory()
1017 
1018         if self.returncode.done():
1019             raise EngineTerminatedError(f"engine process dead (exit code: {self.returncode.result()})")
1020 
1021         assert command.state == CommandState.New
1022 
1023         if self.next_command is not None:
1024             self.next_command.result.cancel()
1025             self.next_command.finished.cancel()
1026             self.next_command._done()
1027 
1028         self.next_command = command
1029 
1030         def previous_command_finished(_: Optional[asyncio.Future[None]]) -> None:
1031             if self.command is not None:
1032                 self.command._done()
1033 
1034             self.command, self.next_command = self.next_command, None
1035             if self.command is not None:
1036                 cmd = self.command
1037 
1038                 def cancel_if_cancelled(result: asyncio.Future[T]) -> None:
1039                     if result.cancelled():
1040                         cmd._cancel(self)
1041 
1042                 cmd.result.add_done_callback(cancel_if_cancelled)
1043                 cmd.finished.add_done_callback(previous_command_finished)
1044                 cmd._start(self)
1045 
1046         if self.command is None:
1047             previous_command_finished(None)
1048         elif not self.command.result.done():
1049             self.command.result.cancel()
1050         elif not self.command.result.cancelled():
1051             self.command._cancel(self)
1052 
1053         return await command.result
1054 
1055     def __repr__(self) -> str:
1056         pid = self.transport.get_pid() if self.transport is not None else "?"
1057         return f"<{type(self).__name__} (pid={pid})>"

1201 class CommandState(enum.Enum):
1202     New = 1
1203     Active = 2
1204     Cancelling = 3
1205     Done = 4
1206 
1207 
1208 class BaseCommand(Generic[ProtocolT, T]):
1209     def __init__(self) -> None:
1210         self.state = CommandState.New
1211 
1212         self.result: asyncio.Future[T] = asyncio.Future()
1213         self.finished: asyncio.Future[None] = asyncio.Future()
1214 
1215     def _engine_terminated(self, engine: ProtocolT, code: int) -> None:
1216         exc = EngineTerminatedError(f"engine process died unexpectedly (exit code: {code})")
1217         if self.state == CommandState.Active:
1218             self.engine_terminated(engine, exc)
1219         elif self.state == CommandState.Cancelling:
1220             self.finished.set_result(None)
1221         elif self.state == CommandState.New:
1222             self._handle_exception(engine, exc)
1223 
1224     def _handle_exception(self, engine: ProtocolT, exc: Exception) -> None:
1225         if not self.result.done():
1226             self.result.set_exception(exc)
1227         else:
1228             engine.loop.call_exception_handler({
1229                 "message": f"{type(self).__name__} failed after returning preliminary result ({self.result!r})",
1230                 "exception": exc,
1231                 "protocol": engine,
1232                 "transport": engine.transport,
1233             })
1234 
1235         if not self.finished.done():
1236             self.finished.set_result(None)
1237 
1238     def set_finished(self) -> None:
1239         assert self.state in [CommandState.Active, CommandState.Cancelling]
1240         if not self.result.done():
1241             self.result.set_exception(EngineError(f"engine command finished before returning result: {self!r}"))
1242         self.finished.set_result(None)
1243 
1244     def _cancel(self, engine: ProtocolT) -> None:
1245         assert self.state == CommandState.Active
1246         self.state = CommandState.Cancelling
1247         self.cancel(engine)
1248 
1249     def _start(self, engine: ProtocolT) -> None:
1250         assert self.state == CommandState.New
1251         self.state = CommandState.Active
1252         try:
1253             self.check_initialized(engine)
1254             self.start(engine)
1255         except EngineError as err:
1256             self._handle_exception(engine, err)
1257 
1258     def _done(self) -> None:
1259         assert self.state != CommandState.Done
1260         self.state = CommandState.Done
1261 
1262     def _line_received(self, engine: ProtocolT, line: str) -> None:
1263         assert self.state in [CommandState.Active, CommandState.Cancelling]
1264         try:
1265             self.line_received(engine, line)
1266         except EngineError as err:
1267             self._handle_exception(engine, err)
1268 
1269     def cancel(self, engine: ProtocolT) -> None:
1270         pass
1271 
1272     def check_initialized(self, engine: ProtocolT) -> None:
1273         if not engine.initialized:
1274             raise EngineError("tried to run command, but engine is not initialized")
1275 
1276     def start(self, engine: ProtocolT) -> None:
1277         raise NotImplementedError
1278 
1279     def line_received(self, engine: ProtocolT, line: str) -> None:
1280         pass
1281 
1282     def engine_terminated(self, engine: ProtocolT, exc: Exception) -> None:
1283         self._handle_exception(engine, exc)
1284 
1285     def __repr__(self) -> str:
1286         return "<{} at {:#x} (state={}, result={}, finished={}>".format(type(self).__name__, id(self), self.state, self.result, self.finished)

1293     protocol.

1296     def __init__(self) -> None:
1297         super().__init__()
1298         self.options: UciOptionMap[Option] = UciOptionMap()
1299         self.config: UciOptionMap[ConfigValue] = UciOptionMap()
1300         self.target_config: UciOptionMap[ConfigValue] = UciOptionMap()
1301         self.id = {}
1302         self.board = chess.Board()

1306     async def initialize(self) -> None:
1307         class UciInitializeCommand(BaseCommand[UciProtocol, None]):
1308             def check_initialized(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1309                 if engine.initialized:
1310                     raise EngineError("engine already initialized")
1311 
1312             def start(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1313                 engine.send_line("uci")
1314 
1315             def line_received(self, engine: UciProtocol, line: str) -> None:
1316                 if line == "uciok" and not self.result.done():
1317                     engine.initialized = True
1318                     self.result.set_result(None)
1319                     self.set_finished()
1320                 elif line.startswith("option "):
1321                     self._option(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
1322                 elif line.startswith("id "):
1323                     self._id(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
1324 
1325             def _option(self, engine: UciProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
1326                 current_parameter = None
1327 
1328                 name: List[str] = []
1329                 type: List[str] = []
1330                 default: List[str] = []
1331                 min = None
1332                 max = None
1333                 current_var = None
1334                 var = []
1335 
1336                 for token in arg.split(" "):
1337                     if token == "name" and not name:
1338                         current_parameter = "name"
1339                     elif token == "type" and not type:
1340                         current_parameter = "type"
1341                     elif token == "default" and not default:
1342                         current_parameter = "default"
1343                     elif token == "min" and min is None:
1344                         current_parameter = "min"
1345                     elif token == "max" and max is None:
1346                         current_parameter = "max"
1347                     elif token == "var":
1348                         current_parameter = "var"
1349                         if current_var is not None:
1350                             var.append(" ".join(current_var))
1351                         current_var = []
1352                     elif current_parameter == "name":
1353                         name.append(token)
1354                     elif current_parameter == "type":
1355                         type.append(token)
1356                     elif current_parameter == "default":
1357                         default.append(token)
1358                     elif current_parameter == "var":
1359                         current_var.append(token)
1360                     elif current_parameter == "min":
1361                         try:
1362                             min = int(token)
1363                         except ValueError:
1364                             LOGGER.exception("Exception parsing option min")
1365                     elif current_parameter == "max":
1366                         try:
1367                             max = int(token)
1368                         except ValueError:
1369                             LOGGER.exception("Exception parsing option max")
1370 
1371                 if current_var is not None:
1372                     var.append(" ".join(current_var))
1373 
1374                 without_default = Option(" ".join(name), " ".join(type), None, min, max, var)
1375                 option = Option(without_default.name, without_default.type, without_default.parse(" ".join(default)), min, max, var)
1376                 engine.options[option.name] = option
1377 
1378                 if option.default is not None:
1379                     engine.config[option.name] = option.default
1380                 if option.default is not None and not option.is_managed() and option.name.lower() != "uci_analysemode":
1381                     engine.target_config[option.name] = option.default
1382 
1383             def _id(self, engine: UciProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
1384                 key, value = arg.split(" ", 1)
1385                 engine.id[key] = value
1386 
1387         return await self.communicate(UciInitializeCommand)

1420     def _setoption(self, name: str, value: ConfigValue) -> None:
1421         try:
1422             value = self.options[name].parse(value)
1423         except KeyError:
1424             raise EngineError("engine does not support option {} (available options: {})".format(name, ", ".join(self.options)))
1425 
1426         if value is None or value != self.config.get(name):
1427             builder = ["setoption name", name]
1428             if value is False:
1429                 builder.append("value false")
1430             elif value is True:
1431                 builder.append("value true")
1432             elif value is not None:
1433                 builder.append("value")
1434                 builder.append(str(value))
1435 
1436             self.send_line(" ".join(builder))
1437             self.config[name] = value

1442                 raise EngineError("cannot set {} which is automatically managed".format(name))
1443             self._setoption(name, value)

1455     def _position(self, board: chess.Board) -> None:
1456         # Select UCI_Variant and UCI_Chess960.
1457         uci_variant = type(board).uci_variant
1458         if "UCI_Variant" in self.options:
1459             self._setoption("UCI_Variant", uci_variant)
1460         elif uci_variant != "chess":
1461             raise EngineError("engine does not support UCI_Variant")
1462 
1463         if "UCI_Chess960" in self.options:
1464             self._setoption("UCI_Chess960", board.chess960)
1465         elif board.chess960:
1466             raise EngineError("engine does not support UCI_Chess960")
1467 
1468         # Send starting position.
1469         builder = ["position"]
1470         safe_history = all(board.move_stack)
1471         root = board.root() if safe_history else board
1472         fen = root.fen(shredder=board.chess960, en_passant="fen")
1473         if uci_variant == "chess" and fen == chess.STARTING_FEN:
1474             builder.append("startpos")
1475         else:
1476             builder.append("fen")
1477             builder.append(fen)
1478 
1479         # Send moves.
1480         if not safe_history:
1481             LOGGER.warning("Not transmitting history with null moves to UCI engine")
1482         elif board.move_stack:
1483             builder.append("moves")
1484             builder.extend(move.uci() for move in board.move_stack)
1485 
1486         self.send_line(" ".join(builder))
1487         self.board = board.copy(stack=False)
1488 
1489     def _go(self, limit: Limit, *, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, ponder: bool = False, infinite: bool = False) -> None:
1490         builder = ["go"]
1491         if ponder:
1492             builder.append("ponder")
1493         if limit.white_clock is not None:
1494             builder.append("wtime")
1495             builder.append(str(max(1, int(limit.white_clock * 1000))))
1496         if limit.black_clock is not None:
1497             builder.append("btime")
1498             builder.append(str(max(1, int(limit.black_clock * 1000))))
1499         if limit.white_inc is not None:
1500             builder.append("winc")
1501             builder.append(str(int(limit.white_inc * 1000)))
1502         if limit.black_inc is not None:
1503             builder.append("binc")
1504             builder.append(str(int(limit.black_inc * 1000)))
1505         if limit.remaining_moves is not None and int(limit.remaining_moves) > 0:
1506             builder.append("movestogo")
1507             builder.append(str(int(limit.remaining_moves)))
1508         if limit.depth is not None:
1509             builder.append("depth")
1510             builder.append(str(max(1, int(limit.depth))))
1511         if limit.nodes is not None:
1512             builder.append("nodes")
1513             builder.append(str(max(1, int(limit.nodes))))
1514         if limit.mate is not None:
1515             builder.append("mate")
1516             builder.append(str(max(1, int(limit.mate))))
1517         if limit.time is not None:
1518             builder.append("movetime")
1519             builder.append(str(max(1, int(limit.time * 1000))))
1520         if infinite:
1521             builder.append("infinite")
1522         if root_moves is not None:
1523             builder.append("searchmoves")
1524             if root_moves:
1525                 builder.extend(move.uci() for move in root_moves)
1526             else:
1527                 # Work around searchmoves followed by nothing.
1528                 builder.append("0000")
1529         self.send_line(" ".join(builder))

1531     async def play(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Limit, *, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_NONE, ponder: bool = False, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> PlayResult:
1532         class UciPlayCommand(BaseCommand[UciProtocol, PlayResult]):
1533             def start(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1534                 self.info: InfoDict = {}
1535                 self.pondering = False
1536                 self.sent_isready = False
1537 
1538                 if "UCI_AnalyseMode" in engine.options and "UCI_AnalyseMode" not in engine.target_config and all(name.lower() != "uci_analysemode" for name in options):
1539                     engine._setoption("UCI_AnalyseMode", False)
1540                 if "Ponder" in engine.options:
1541                     engine._setoption("Ponder", ponder)
1542                 if "MultiPV" in engine.options:
1543                     engine._setoption("MultiPV", engine.options["MultiPV"].default)
1544 
1545                 engine._configure(options)
1546 
1547                 if engine.first_game or engine.game != game:
1548                     engine.game = game
1549                     engine._ucinewgame()
1550                     self.sent_isready = True
1551                     engine._isready()
1552                 else:
1553                     self._readyok(engine)
1554 
1555             def line_received(self, engine: UciProtocol, line: str) -> None:
1556                 if line.startswith("info "):
1557                     self._info(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
1558                 elif line.startswith("bestmove "):
1559                     self._bestmove(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
1560                 elif line == "readyok" and self.sent_isready:
1561                     self._readyok(engine)
1562                 else:
1563                     LOGGER.warning("%s: Unexpected engine output: %r", engine, line)
1564 
1565             def _readyok(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1566                 self.sent_isready = False
1567                 engine._position(board)
1568                 engine._go(limit, root_moves=root_moves)
1569 
1570             def _info(self, engine: UciProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
1571                 if not self.pondering:
1572                     self.info.update(_parse_uci_info(arg, engine.board, info))
1573 
1574             def _bestmove(self, engine: UciProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
1575                 if self.pondering:
1576                     self.pondering = False
1577                 elif not self.result.cancelled():
1578                     best = _parse_uci_bestmove(engine.board, arg)
1579                     self.result.set_result(PlayResult(best.move, best.ponder, self.info))
1580 
1581                     if ponder and best.move and best.ponder:
1582                         self.pondering = True
1583                         engine.board.push(best.move)
1584                         engine.board.push(best.ponder)
1585                         engine._position(engine.board)
1586                         engine._go(limit, ponder=True)
1587 
1588                 if not self.pondering:
1589                     self.end(engine)
1590 
1591             def end(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1592                 self.set_finished()
1593 
1594             def cancel(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1595                 engine.send_line("stop")
1596 
1597             def engine_terminated(self, engine: UciProtocol, exc: Exception) -> None:
1598                 # Allow terminating engine while pondering.
1599                 if not self.result.done():
1600                     super().engine_terminated(engine, exc)
1601 
1602         return await self.communicate(UciPlayCommand)

1604     async def analysis(self, board: chess.Board, limit: Optional[Limit] = None, *, multipv: Optional[int] = None, game: object = None, info: Info = INFO_ALL, root_moves: Optional[Iterable[chess.Move]] = None, options: ConfigMapping = {}) -> AnalysisResult:

1611                     engine._setoption("UCI_AnalyseMode", True)
1612                 if "MultiPV" in engine.options or (multipv and multipv > 1):
1613                     engine._setoption("MultiPV", 1 if multipv is None else multipv)
1614 
1615                 engine._configure(options)
1616 
1617                 if engine.first_game or engine.game != game:
1618                     engine.game = game
1619                     engine._ucinewgame()
1620                     self.sent_isready = True
1621                     engine._isready()
1622                 else:
1623                     self._readyok(engine)

1625             def line_received(self, engine: UciProtocol, line: str) -> None:
1626                 if line.startswith("info "):
1627                     self._info(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
1628                 elif line.startswith("bestmove "):
1629                     self._bestmove(engine, line.split(" ", 1)[1])
1630                 elif line == "readyok" and self.sent_isready:
1631                     self._readyok(engine)

1635             def _readyok(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:

1641                 else:
1642                     engine._go(Limit(), root_moves=root_moves, infinite=True)

1646             def _info(self, engine: UciProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
1647                 self.analysis.post(_parse_uci_info(arg, engine.board, info))

1649             def _bestmove(self, engine: UciProtocol, arg: str) -> None:
1650                 if not self.result.done():
1651                     raise EngineError("was not searching, but engine sent bestmove")
1652                 best = _parse_uci_bestmove(engine.board, arg)
1653                 self.set_finished()
1654                 self.analysis.set_finished(best)
1655 
1656             def cancel(self, engine: UciProtocol) -> None:
1657                 engine.send_line("stop")
1658 
1659             def engine_terminated(self, engine: UciProtocol, exc: Exception) -> None:
1660                 LOGGER.debug("%s: Closing analysis because engine has been terminated (error: %s)", engine, exc)
1661                 self.analysis.set_exception(exc)
1662 
1663         return await self.communicate(UciAnalysisCommand)

1672 def _parse_uci_info(arg: str, root_board: chess.Board, selector: Info = INFO_ALL) -> InfoDict:
1673     info: InfoDict = {}
1674     if not selector:
1675         return info
1676 
1677     tokens = arg.split(" ")
1678     while tokens:
1679         parameter = tokens.pop(0)
1680 
1681         if parameter == "string":
1682             info["string"] = " ".join(tokens)
1683             break
1684         elif parameter in ["depth", "seldepth", "nodes", "multipv", "currmovenumber", "hashfull", "nps", "tbhits", "cpuload"]:

1695             try:
1696                 info["ebf"] = float(tokens.pop(0))
1697             except (ValueError, IndexError):
1698                 LOGGER.error("Exception parsing %s from info: %r", parameter, arg)
1699         elif parameter == "score" and selector & INFO_SCORE:

1701                 kind = tokens.pop(0)
1702                 value = tokens.pop(0)
1703                 if tokens and tokens[0] in ["lowerbound", "upperbound"]:
1704                     info[tokens.pop(0)] = True  # type: ignore

1706                     info["score"] = PovScore(Cp(int(value)), root_board.turn)

1720                 if "currline" not in info:

1722 
1723                 cpunr = int(tokens.pop(0))
1724                 currline: List[chess.Move] = []
1725                 info["currline"][cpunr] = currline
1726 
1727                 board = root_board.copy(stack=False)
1728                 while tokens and UCI_REGEX.match(tokens[0]):
1729                     currline.append(board.push_uci(tokens.pop(0)))
1730             except (ValueError, IndexError):
1731                 LOGGER.error("Exception parsing currline from info: %r, position at root: %s", arg, root_board.fen())
1732         elif parameter == "refutation" and selector & INFO_REFUTATION:
1733             try:
1734                 if "refutation" not in info:
1735                     info["refutation"] = {}
1736 
1737                 board = root_board.copy(stack=False)
1738                 refuted = board.push_uci(tokens.pop(0))
1739 
1740                 refuted_by: List[chess.Move] = []
1741                 info["refutation"][refuted] = refuted_by
1742 
1743                 while tokens and UCI_REGEX.match(tokens[0]):
1744                     refuted_by.append(board.push_uci(tokens.pop(0)))
1745             except (ValueError, IndexError):
1746                 LOGGER.error("Exception parsing refutation from info: %r, position at root: %s", arg, root_board.fen())
1747         elif parameter == "pv" and selector & INFO_PV:
1748             try:
1749                 pv: List[chess.Move] = []
1750                 info["pv"] = pv
1751                 board = root_board.copy(stack=False)
1752                 while tokens and UCI_REGEX.match(tokens[0]):
1753                     pv.append(board.push_uci(tokens.pop(0)))
1754             except (ValueError, IndexError):
1755                 LOGGER.error("Exception parsing pv from info: %r, position at root: %s", arg, root_board.fen())
1756         elif parameter == "wdl":
1757             try:
1758                 info["wdl"] = PovWdl(Wdl(int(tokens.pop(0)), int(tokens.pop(0)), int(tokens.pop(0))), root_board.turn)

1760                 LOGGER.error("Exception parsing wdl from info: %r", arg)

1764 def _parse_uci_bestmove(board: chess.Board, args: str) -> BestMove:
1765     tokens = args.split(None, 2)
1766 
1767     move = None
1768     ponder = None
1769 
1770     if tokens[0] not in ["(none)", "NULL"]:
1771         try:
1772             # AnMon 5.75 uses uppercase letters to denote promotion types.
1773             move = board.push_uci(tokens[0].lower())
1774         except ValueError as err:
1775             raise EngineError(err)
1776 
1777         try:
1778             # Houdini 1.5 sends NULL instead of skipping the token.
1779             if len(tokens) >= 3 and tokens[1] == "ponder" and tokens[2] not in ["(none)", "NULL"]:
1780                 ponder = board.parse_uci(tokens[2].lower())
1781         except ValueError:
1782             LOGGER.exception("Engine sent invalid ponder move")
1783         finally:
1784             board.pop()
1785 
1786     return BestMove(move, ponder)

1911                 if not engine.features.get("reuse", 1):

1914                 if not engine.features.get("sigterm", 1):

1961     def _new(self, board: chess.Board, game: object, options: ConfigMapping) -> None:
1962         self._configure(options)
1963 
1964         # Set up starting position.
1965         root = board.root()
1966         new_options = "random" in options or "computer" in options
1967         new_game = self.first_game or self.game != game or new_options or root != self.board.root()
1968         self.game = game
1969         self.first_game = False
1970         if new_game:
1971             self.board = root
1972             self.send_line("new")
1973 
1974             variant = type(board).xboard_variant
1975             if variant == "normal" and board.chess960:
1976                 self._variant("fischerandom")
1977             elif variant != "normal":
1978                 self._variant(variant)
1979 
1980             if self.config.get("random"):
1981                 self.send_line("random")
1982             if self.config.get("computer"):
1983                 self.send_line("computer")
1984 
1985         self.send_line("force")
1986 
1987         if new_game:
1988             fen = root.fen(shredder=board.chess960, en_passant="fen")
1989             if variant != "normal" or fen != chess.STARTING_FEN or board.chess960:
1990                 self.send_line(f"setboard {fen}")
1991 
1992         # Undo moves until common position.
1993         common_stack_len = 0
1994         if not new_game:
1995             for left, right in zip(self.board.move_stack, board.move_stack):
1996                 if left == right:
1997                     common_stack_len += 1
1998                 else:
1999                     break
2000 
2001             while len(self.board.move_stack) > common_stack_len + 1:
2002                 self.send_line("remove")
2003                 self.board.pop()
2004                 self.board.pop()
2005 
2006             while len(self.board.move_stack) > common_stack_len:
2007                 self.send_line("undo")
2008                 self.board.pop()
2009 
2010         # Play moves from board stack.
2011         for move in board.move_stack[common_stack_len:]:
2012             if not move:
2013                 LOGGER.warning("Null move (in %s) may not be supported by all XBoard engines", self.board.fen())
2014             self.send_line(self.board.xboard(move))
2015             self.board.push(move)
